polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon, apple-touch-icon, OG 1200x630, theme-color, JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness, print stylesheet, lazy images with dimensions, forced colors handled, consistent 2px radius. 1440-full.jpg: footer credits styled consistently. 390-first.jpg: mobile bar buttons visually differentiated.

elevate.move: Thread the flue-rail signature into the checker and services sections as a structural element rather than margin decoration — make symptom cards hang from the rail as level-tagged nodes, and let the services grid break its uniform columns where the rail passes through, turning the signature from an ornamental border into the organising spine of every section.

Differentiate entrance patterns by content role so that text, images, and interactive tools each have a distinct reveal language — text rises, images unclip vertically, and tool outputs slide in horizontally along the flue-rail axis — creating a motion vocabulary that reinforces the chimney-as-site metaphor rather than applying a single fade-up universally.
